title: The interplay of chromatin phase separation and lamina interactions in nuclear organization.
authors: Laghmach, Rabia; Di Pierro, Michele; Potoyan, Davit A
one_liner_zh: 该文用场论模型模拟细胞核内染色质多相凝聚体的相分离动力学，虽对象为染色质而非典型IDP，但聚焦相分离介导的核内互作与组织机制，其建模思路对IDR介导PPI的相分离机制研究有可迁移启发。
abstract: The genetic material of eukaryotes is segregated into transcriptionally active euchromatin and silent heterochromatin compartments. The spatial arrangement of chromatin compartments evolves over the course of cellular life in a process that remains poorly understood. The latest nuclear imaging experiments reveal a number of dynamical signatures of chromatin that are reminiscent of active multiphase liquids. This includes the observations of viscoelastic response, coherent motions, Ostwald ripening, and coalescence of chromatin compartments. There is also growing evidence that liquid-liquid phase separation of protein and nucleic acid components is the underlying mechanism for the dynamical behavior of chromatin. To dissect the organizational and dynamical implications of chromatin's liquid behavior, we have devised a phenomenological field-theoretic model of the nucleus as a multiphase condensate of liquid chromatin types. Employing the liquid chromatin model of the Drosophila nucleus, we have carried out an extensive set of simulations with an objective to shed light on the dynamics and chromatin patterning observed in the latest nuclear imaging experiments. Our simulations reveal the emergence of experimentally detected mesoscale chromatin channels and spheroidal droplets which arise from the dynamic interplay of chromatin type to type interactions and intermingling of chromosomal territories. We also quantitatively reproduce coherent motions of chromatin domains observed in displacement correlation spectroscopy measurements which are explained within the framework of our model by phase separation of chromatin types operating within constrained intrachromosomal and interchromosomal boundaries. Finally, we illuminate the role of heterochromatin-lamina interactions in the nuclear organization by showing that these interactions enhance the mobility of euchromatin and indirectly introduce correlated motions of heterochromatin droplets.
abstract_zh: 真核生物的遗传物质被分隔为转录活跃的常染色质和沉默的异染色质区室。染色质区室的空间排列在细胞生命过程中演化，这一过程至今仍知之甚少。最新的核成像实验揭示了染色质的若干动力学特征，这些特征 reminiscent of 活性多相液体。这包括对粘弹性响应、相干运动、奥斯特瓦尔德熟化以及染色质区室合并的观察。越来越多的证据也表明，蛋白质和核酸组分的液-液相分离 (liquid-liquid phase separation) 是染色质动力学行为的潜在机制。为了剖析染色质液体行为的组织和动力学意义，我们设计了一个现象学场论模型，将细胞核视为液态染色质类型的多相凝聚体。利用果蝇细胞核的液态染色质模型，我们进行了一系列广泛的模拟，旨在阐明最新核成像实验中观察到的动力学和染色质模式。我们的模拟揭示了实验检测到的介观尺度染色质通道和球形液滴的出现，这些源于染色质类型间相互作用的动态博弈以及染色体区域的交织。我们还定量重现了位移相关光谱测量中观察到的染色质域的相干运动，这在我们模型的框架内通过染色质类型在受限的染色体内和染色体间边界内的相分离得到解释。最后，我们阐明了异染色质-核纤层相互作用在核组织中的作用，表明这些相互作用增强了常染色质的流动性，并间接引入了异染色质液滴的相关运动。
